commit.message:
Use side-effect-free node budget check, update cost estimate

- Replace C->check_node_count() (which has side effects of marking
  the method as not compilable) with a plain comparison against
  C->live_nodes() + C->max_node_limit()
- Update per-argument estimate from 150 to 330 based on worst-case
  measurement from bug reporter

8387067: C2: Live Node limit exceeded for large string concats

Check the node budget before expanding a string concat optimization.
If the estimated node cost (num_arguments * 150) would exceed the
remaining node limit, skip the optimization and let the method run
via the unoptimized StringBuilder path.
